items.title: WARNING: India's Classrooms Are Already Using AI but the Rules Have Not Even Been Written Yet
items.summary:
82% of government teachers in India are using AI tools, yet sensitive student data is being exposed without national rules.

New survey data reveals a rapid adoption of AI in education across India. While the majority of teachers report a positive outlook on these tools, the speed of integration is moving much faster than current institutional oversight. We break down the gap between classroom experimentation and the critical need for a unified framework for AI regulations.

The primary concern centers on data privacy, as government teachers frequently input sensitive student information into public models without adequate safeguards. This episode examines the risks of this unregulated usage and what school administrators must prioritize to protect information while fostering innovation in the classroom.

items.title: The 1919 Eclipse Test Inside A Transformer
items.summary: In episode 1025 of the SuperDataScience Podcast, Jon Krohn talks with Dr. Luis Serrano, Founder of Serrano Academy about Eddington's 1919 eclipse experiment, where light from a star bent around the sun. He draws a fascinating analogy to how words like 'bank' bend their path around 'river' in a transformer's embedding space. This unique perspective offers a visual way to understand the complex interactions within large language models.

items.title: MCP & MCP Runner: The Protocol Behind Agent Communication
items.summary:
Connecting an agent to a new tool used to mean custom integration work every single time. MCP is the standard that removes that.

Terms covered:
- MCP (Model Context Protocol): a standardized way for AI models to communicate with external tools and data sources. One standard, many integrations.
- MCP Runner: the runtime component that manages those connections and makes sure the interactions happen reliably at scale

In practice: a healthcare organization connects an agent to patient records, scheduling and compliance tools through the same protocol. A financial services firm links market data, risk systems and reporting without rebuilding the connection layer each time.

MCP defines how agents talk to the world. The MCP Runner makes those conversations happen.

—
AI Fundamentals Glossary | H2O.ai University

Anthropic has accused Chinese AI labs of using AI model distillation to scrape Claude's capabilities for their own models.

Anthropic has formally alleged that multiple Chinese AI labs are systematically extracting capabilities from its models. This unauthorized practice, known as AI model distillation, involves using outputs to train competing systems. Reports specifically implicate Moonshot AI, which allegedly saved customer exchanges to refine its own software, while Alibaba is cited for using Anthropic Claude to advance its reinforcement learning environments.

This incident highlights the growing tension around generative AI security and intellectual property protection in the global market. As labs race to build superior systems, reliance on the outputs of established frontier models for model training has sparked a debate over the ethics of data usage. We examine what this means for data integrity and the future of proprietary AI development.

items.title: OpenAI’s GPT-6 Astra (Ep. 1026 with Jon Krohn)
items.summary:
In Episode #1026, @JonKrohnLearns breaks down GPT-6 Astra, OpenAI’s new flagship that its president has floated as a possible marker of AGI. Jon covers what the model is, what it costs, its state-of-the-art results across computer use, coding, abstract reasoning and science and the safety story, which for this release is unusually intertwined with capability. He weighs the AGI claim against Anthropic’s Fable 5.1 and lands, as ever, in a measured middle.

Additional materials: https://www.superdatascience.com/1026

items.title: Ultraviolette Commits ₹7.79 Billion for Hosur EV Factory | John Ternus Debuts iPhone Duo
items.summary:
Electric two-wheeler manufacturer Ultraviolette Automotive announced a ₹7.79 billion (₹779 crore) investment over the next five years to build a massive new manufacturing plant in Hosur, Tamil Nadu. The facility will scale production capacity to 2.5 lakh units annually as the Bengaluru-based EV maker targets volume expansion into mass-market electric two-wheelers and scooters. Globally, Apple CEO John Ternus unveiled the foldable iPhone Duo at the "Surprise and Shine" event. Meanwhile, IDFC FIRST Bank teamed up with Sarvam AI to build a self-improving bank, the RBI warned lenders about automated AI decisioning risks, US federal prosecutors opened a criminal trial accusing Huawei of IP theft, OpenAI urged Congress for binding AI safety laws, space startup GalaxEye won a US patent for OptoSAR technology, and founders Parth Sarthi of Chariot and Vivekanand Pani of Coremantle join us live.
